sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Disable tracking
Stops Firebase Analytics and AppMetrica from collecting and sending usage data.
Keep timed media
Stops photos, videos and voice messages with a timer from self-destructing after you open them. Media Telegram's servers already deleted can't be restored.
Remove ads
Removes banner, interstitial, native, app open and rewarded ads, Graph's own promotions, Telegram sponsored messages and the proxy sponsor channel.
Remove forced update
Removes the dialog that blocks the app when Graph marks this version unsupported.
Remove restrictions
Allows copying, forwarding, saving and screenshots in chats and channels that restrict them.
Unlock premium
Unlocks Graph Premium and Telegram Premium features in the client. Features Telegram's servers meter still need a Premium account.

sources.label: Patch for Android application and implementation of new features.
sources.author: Wagg13Patch_Morphe
patch_list: Keep timed media
Stops photos, videos and voice messages with a timer from being treated as self-destructing media.
Remove forced update
Removes the blocking dialog shown when Graph marks the installed version as outdated.
Remove restrictions
Allows copying, forwarding, saving and screenshots in restricted chats and channels.
Remove Telegraph ads
Removes sponsored messages, video ads and the sponsored proxy.
Remove Telegraph trackers
Disables AppMetrica (usage analytics and crash reports).
Remove third-party ad SDKs
Blocks third-party ad networks bundled inside the app.
Spoof Telegraph signature
Restores original signature verification so the app can open after being patched.
Unlock Telegraph Premium

Makes Telegraph treat the current account as Premium and disables the app's own license/trial system (which also controls ad display). Client-side only; features that depend on the Telegram server still require a real Premium account.
